program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((marker (find (lambda (p) p)
                                (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                                  (and (= (at g r c) 5) (list r c)))))
                  (mc (second marker))
                  (bar-info (filter (lambda (x) x)
                                    (for/list ((r (range 0 h)))
                                      (let ((len (count-if (lambda (c)
                                                             (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                                               (and
                                                                 (!= v 0)
                                                                 (not (and
                                                                        (= r
                                                                           (first marker))
                                                                        (= c mc))))))
                                                           (range 0 w))))
                                        (if (zero? len) #f (list r len))))))
                  (lengths (map second bar-info))
                  (dup-lengths (map second
                                    (filter (lambda (bi)
                                              (not (for/or ((c (range 0 w)))
                                                           (= (at g (first bi) c) 5))))
                                            bar-info)))
                  (dup-len (find (lambda (l)
                                   (> (count-if (lambda (x) (= x l)) dup-lengths) 1))
                                 dup-lengths)))
             (reduce (lambda (acc bi)
                       (let* ((r (first bi))
                              (len (second bi))
                              (base (if (and dup-len (!= len dup-len))
                                        (- len dup-len)
                                        (- len 1)))
                              (val (remainder (* base base) 10)))
                         (set-cell acc r mc val)))
                     g
                     bar-info)))))
